collection.description: A villager tells a favorite story about a lost pearl, and a friend goes quiet: it was their story.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For years (subject) has been telling a story about the time (subject.he/she) found a huge pearl in a clam and lost it in the sand on the way home. Today (subject.he/she) tells it again, and (friend) goes very quiet. "That's my story," (friend.he/she) says. "That happened to me. I told it to you when we were twelve."

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Well," says (subject), slightly pink, "it's a very good story." "It is," says (friend). "That's why I told it." They agree that (friend) can have the pearl, and (subject) can keep telling it as long as (subject.he/she) gets the ending right. (subject) admits (subject.he/she) may have added a seagull.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) thinks hard, and realizes (friend) is right. "I'm so sorry. I think I've been telling your story for years." (friend) laughs. "Was I good in it?" "You were wonderful. You lost the pearl very bravely." From then on, (subject) always starts it with "This happened to (friend)..."
